capabilities: Record and transcribe speech into the current note
Correct spoken names against a terms note via a second Gemini call
Insert wiki-links for spoken note names from a link phrases note
Polish transcripts at Light, Full, or Off levels
Verify and manage a Gemini API key in settings
extras: Warns that the API key is stored in plain text in the vault's plugin settings file and will be carried by any sync or backup of .obsidian. Requires Obsidian 1.13+ (older versions get 0.3.1). Detailed network behavior documented in docs/gemini-request.md; recordings go only to Google, no telemetry. iOS/iPad support untested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictation, and typing on a phone or getting names spelled correctly from speech-to-text is slow and error-prone.

relations.evidence: It runs on your own Gemini API key, with no account: the take goes from your device to Google

requires.name: Google account (to create a key in Google AI Studio)

summary: Voice dictation plugin that records a take, transcribes it with the Gemini API, cleans the text, and inserts it at the cursor with spoken names spelled right and optionally wiki-linked.
